semantic.justification: Owns native SAX measure parsing for the implemented Twip and MM100 targets: UTF-8 attribute-view whitespace, optional unit, supported absolute units, target-dependent pixel acceptance, signed half-away rounding and caller/default int32 saturation. Source-derived tests and 95 cases against compiled unmodified pinned parser/measure functions verify these bounded contracts. The harness supplies platform types and native conversion ratios for these two targets. Other conversion APIs, target units and the UTF-16 overload remain unimplemented/unverified; no whole-module parity is claimed. For the existing LABEL_ALIGNMENT mode and LISTTAB/SPACE/NOTHING separators, source-owned xmlnumi parsing now retains zero defaults and MM100 fields with native Converter grammar/failure and SHRT bounds. The MM100 import port now carries both independent native geometry groups; the earlier legacy-to-alignment Twip emulation is removed. Writer numbering property conversion follows unosett.cxx signed MM100/Twip ratios; export projects native MM100 and delegates CM serialization to XML/SAX. ODF 1.3 XML emits explicit label-alignment mode and retains standard command geometry; indents are nonzero-only and tab position is exported only for LISTTAB with a positive value. Context/core assertions and eleven literal common/automatic ODT cases plus both default command marker families verify native quantization, conditional XML and manual reopen state. Full numbering/UNO, legacy position mode/property ownership, NEWLINE extensions, other XML units/versions, defaults and wider obligations remain unverified; no whole-module promotion. Preserve ASCII space/tab,sign,group separators,legacy INF/NAN,partial exponent,no-conversion,status and rounded legacy DBL_MAX behavior. Typed-array views adapt native pointer ranges without allocation/refcount simulation. Native QA and independent binary64 ties/subnormal boundaries verify represented values;NaN payload/physical ABI and other RTL numeric APIs are not claimed. SAX read overloads delegate this single shared owner;no numeric writer/unit overload or complete Calc document/UI/ODS claim.
